description: a blind hole whose wall touches a side face from inside (tangent-hole's contact at the band survey's numbers and pose), turned about the contact's middle so its ends move a tolerance (1e-7) out through the face and back. Arris builds a body the checker refuses: S5, two faces intersect away from their shared edges — the section of the face's plane and the hole's wall, a hair off tangent, fitted apart from what the checker traces. Unposed it is Fault::Split, Dangling, as in tangent-hole-a-tolerance-out. The desired result is the tangent contact's refusal by name, as at the contact and in tangent-hole-a-tolerance-out. Open CASCADE builds a shell of odd Euler characteristic, as for tangent-hole (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
